title: TaskShowOutput
description: Output of `gentry task show --json`. The path is always full: --path changes only the text output.

task.description: The task named, or the task of the current worktree.

path.description: The passes of the task in the order entered; the last one is current unless the scenario is passed, and holds the steps of the current stage.

notes.description: Notes of the task by number.

artifacts.description: Artifacts of the task by name.

operator_decisions.description: Decisions of the operator by number; empty if there are none. --statement changes only the text output.
